note: m_base_kg is the UI chassis mass, 540 kg (decision D2); the driver is a separate 82 kg line, the C4.5.2 floor. wheelbase_m is the 2026 limit, 3.40 m (decision D3). cg_height_m is the UI default. tire_radius_m is the Core doc default (about 0.33 m, to be calibrated). position_frac is each part's longitudinal position as a fraction of the wheelbase behind the front axle; these are PLACEHOLDERS chosen so the stock car carries about 44.5 % of its weight on the front axle, inside the C4.2 limits (front at least 44 %, rear at least 54 %). Track width, k_axle, roll split and C_alpha are added by the phases that need them.
